title: Underwriting Manual: Issue Ages and Medicare Eligibility Conditions for Each Plan Letter
content:
No policy under Medicare Supplement Insurance Policies may be issued outside the ages the letter carries, and every letter requires the applicant to be enrolled in Medicare Part B. Whether a letter may be issued to a Medicare beneficiary under 65 differs from letter to letter.

| Policy | Youngest issue age | Oldest issue age | Issued to a Medicare beneficiary under 65 | Part B enrolment required |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan A | 65 | 99 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan B | 65 | 99 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan D | 65 | 89 | no | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan K | 65 | 99 | yes | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan N | 65 | 89 | no | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement Plan G | 65 | 85 | no | yes |
| Ridgecrest Medicare Supplement High Deductible Plan G | 65 | 85 | no | yes |

### Applying the table

The youngest issue age is 65 on every letter and enrolment in Medicare Part B is required on every letter, so neither condition distinguishes one letter from another.

The oldest issue age falls into three bands: 99 on Plan A, Plan B and Plan K; 89 on Plan D and Plan N; and 85 on Plan G and High Deductible Plan G. An applicant whose age at application is above the oldest issue age the letter carries is outside that letter's issue ages.

A Medicare beneficiary under 65 may be issued Plan A, Plan B or Plan K. Plan D, Plan N, Plan G and High Deductible Plan G are not issued to a Medicare beneficiary under 65.
